description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Andromeda Systems Incorporated (ASI) develops enterprise software for physical asset managers. The Junior Software Developer will build and enhance web-based applications using .NET, Angular, and SQL, collaborating with technical teams throughout project delivery.
Junior Software Developer building .NET applications with C#, microservices, and Angular; querying SQL data and integrating components.

Responsibilities:
• In a .Net environment, code, test, debug, and implement custom application in C# utilizing microservices techniques along with Angular 2+
• Utilize SQL to pull, query, and join data using TSQL as necessary
• Integrate multiple components potentially across disparate applications
• Write technical specifications and other forms of documentation
• Innovate on tools and processes that simplify and expedite achieving development goals
• Collaborate with other technical teams (DevOps, Database, QA Testers, and Analysts) to ensure successful delivery of projects from testing to integration to deployment

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field from an accredited U.S. institution
• 0–2 years of professional software development experience
• Working knowledge of C# and the .NET framework and .NET Core
• Understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web design principles
• Basic knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including writing SQL queries and understanding relational database concepts
• Familiarity with object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and software design fundamentals
• Understanding of RESTful APIs and client/server application architecture
• Basic understanding of debugging, testing, and troubleshooting software applications
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Effective verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work collaboratively in an Agile/Scrum development environment
• Must be a U.S. Citizen
• Candidate must be capable of obtaining a secret security clearance if required for future project assignments

Preferred:
• Internship, co-op, academic, or personal project experience using Angular, C#, or SQL Server
• Familiarity with Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core
• Exposure to Azure DevOps, GitHub, or other CI/CD tools
• Knowledge of unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Jasmine, or Karma)
• Understanding of dependency injection and modern software architecture patterns
• Experience in consuming or developing REST APIs
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure
• Experience with Agile development methodologies
• Familiarity with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar) to improve productivity in coding, debugging, testing, and documentation while validating AI-generated output for accuracy, security, and maintainability
